projects.name: Vela desktop app
notes: Frontend is SvelteKit/TypeScript configured as a static SPA.
Backend is Rust and owns media sources, config persistence, source mounting, and mpv playback.

projects.name: E2E harness
notes: Drives the real debug binary via tauri-driver + a vendored WebKitWebDriver (fetch-driver.sh, gitignored vendor/) on a private Xvfb display; throwaway XDG_CONFIG_HOME per scenario.
Design and deviations live in .agents/plans/e2e-harness.md; six scenarios as of 2026-07-05 (smoke, playback, curation, resume, queue, search).

projects.name: Linux packaging
projects.type: Tauri bundle files and Arch package files
notes: Tauri Linux bundle scripts install desktop database and icon cache refresh hooks.
Arch packaging expects a built release binary under src-tauri/target/release/vela.

verification.status: Commands below are confirmed present in package.json scripts and .github/workflows/ci.yml. CI execution is split across two remotes (`git remote -v`): `origin` (self-hosted Gitea, http://q:3000/michael/vela.git) does NOT run .github/workflows/* - no `.gitea/workflows/` directory exists (Gitea's actual trigger path), and Gitea's Actions runs API previously returned zero runs. `github` (https://github.com/roethlar/vela.git) DOES run it: `gh api repos/roethlar/vela/actions/runs` on 2026-07-04 showed 7 completed runs, the most recent (2026-07-03) concluding `success` on `main` - GitHub Actions is confirmed ACTIVE there. This corrects an earlier record that called ci.yml/release.yml dead; that conclusion only checked the Gitea origin and missed the github remote. Still run these commands locally before claiming completion - do not rely on CI alone, since it only covers pushes that reach the github remote.

commands.when: Production frontend build or any change that can affect the Tauri frontend bundle.

End-to-end UI/playback validation on Linux (drives the real debug app headless on Xvfb; needs tauri-driver, Xvfb, ffmpeg, mpv, bsdtar, curl — see tests/e2e/README.md). Use `-- --skip-build` to reuse the existing debug binary, `-- <name>` for one scenario.

packaging_commands.when: Linux .deb/.rpm bundle changes, when the local system has Tauri Linux prerequisites.
Arch packaging changes, when makepkg and package prerequisites are available.

policy.code_changes: Run current automated verification before claiming completion.
policy.docs_only: Code verification is not required unless docs affect setup, commands, runtime behavior, generated files, or user-visible behavior.
policy.manual_behavior: Run the relevant manual check, smoke test, or playtest for behavior not covered by automation, or state clearly that it was not run.

notes: CI installs Tauri WebKitGTK/libsoup/GTK dependencies before Rust checks on Linux.
README says live integration for Emby, local, and SMB paths is still pending even where unit-tested; Jellyfin was smoke-tested live on 2026-07-04.

Audited 2026-07-05: the previously-noted deferred issue (blocking filesystem traversal inside async source methods) is resolved — local.rs routes traversal-heavy methods and resolve_stream through run_blocking, and all mount/unmount call sites in commands.rs use spawn_blocking. The ISSUES.md Kimi P0 items were re-verified against current code the same day.
